crossRefs.note: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,
for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.
When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him,

people.name: Capernaum
people.line: Town in Galilee; center of Jesus' ministry

translations.web: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
translations.bsb: When Jesus had concluded His discourse in the hearing of the people, He went to Capernaum.
translations.kjv: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
translations.asv: After he had ended all his sayings in the ears of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
